question: Taux de respect des délais SLA par agence en 2026
reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(agency, service_point, 'Non spécifié') AS agency_name, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN (resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at <= sla_due_at) OR (resolved_at IS NULL AND sla_due_at >= '2026-10-15') THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS sla_rate FROM reporting_claim WHERE claim_type = 'CLAIM' AND receipt_at >= '2026-01-01' AND receipt_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY COALESCE(agency, service_point, 'Non spécifié') ORDER BY sla_rate DESC

question: Top 3 des agences avec le plus grand nombre de réclamations
reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(agency, service_point, 'Non spécifié') AS agency_name, COUNT(*) AS total FROM reporting_claim WHERE claim_type = 'CLAIM' GROUP BY COALESCE(agency, service_point, 'Non spécifié') ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3

question: Délai moyen de traitement des réclamations par canal en 2026
reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(channel, 'Non spécifié') AS channel_name, ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(resolved_at, receipt_at)), 2) AS avg_days FROM reporting_claim WHERE claim_type = 'CLAIM' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND receipt_at >= '2026-01-01' AND receipt_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY COALESCE(channel, 'Non spécifié') ORDER BY avg_days DESC

question: Taux de satisfaction des usagers par canal de collecte
reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(channel, 'Non spécifié') AS channel_name, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'SATISFIED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN status IN ('SATISFIED', 'UNSATISFIED') THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS satisfaction_rate FROM reporting_claim GROUP BY COALESCE(channel, 'Non spécifié') ORDER BY satisfaction_rate DESC
